hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git push'; then COUNT_FILE=".claude/push_count"; mkdir -p .claude; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); COUNT=$((COUNT + 1)); if [ "$COUNT" -ge 3 ]; then echo 0 > "$COUNT_FILE"; echo "3 pushes completed. Please run /code-review to identify refactoring and scalability opportunities across the codebase."; exit 2; else echo "$COUNT" > "$COUNT_FILE"; fi; fi
hooks.rewakeSummary: 3 pushes reached — time for a code review
